description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_TemplateBase' which includes shared methods and properties for template handling within the Smarty templating engine. It handles template rendering, caching, plugin registration, and object registration functionalities.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TemplateBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing shared template handling methods for Smarty.

properties.name: cache_id
properties.description: Identifier for cache files for the same templates.

properties.name: compile_id
properties.description: Identifier for compiled files for the same templates.

properties.name: tplFunctions
properties.description: Array of source information for template functions.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Renders a Smarty template and returns the output string.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if the template is cached and valid.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal method to execute rendering or cache checking of templates.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin for use in templates.

methods.name: loadFilter
methods.description: Loads a filter of a specified type and name.

methods.name: registerObject
methods.description: Registers an object to be used in templates.
